toolchain.scope: existing tool installation; no installation or native action

supported_scope: one explicitly configured app/workspace/actor/channel/thread; ordinary text-only message create
real_boundaries: existing Admission authorization gate and SQLite transactions
fresh-process SQLite deduplication and mirror suppression
fake_boundaries: synthetic signing secret; independent hmac.digest signer plus manual SHA256 inner/outer-pad signer

validation.aggregate_interpreter_scope: existing child commands retain normal Python; separate full -O suite verifies optimized execution

mutations.historical_thread_only_mutation: remained_rejected_by_independent_downstream_identity_binding; replaced rather than counted as detected

limits: no HTTP listener, deployment, subscriptions or acknowledgment
no edit/delete revision mapping or structured/rich-text messages
no atomic post-lock revocation guarantee beyond existing Admission
no hostile in-process code or debugger/frame-local secrecy guarantee
protected_scope: all preexisting tracked files, STATUS, provenance, existing receipts, workflows, image gates and pins unchanged
review_corrections: Explicit callback/event/authorization workspace and Enterprise routing fields now fail closed before authority; manual-HMAC negatives observe zero authority/store effects.
